Metadata.title: Customer Ticketing System
Metadata.description: A bilingual customer support platform for submitting, tracking and resolving service requests.

Home.title: Support that moves at your pace.
Home.subtitle: A bilingual customer portal and a focused support console — one place to raise, track and resolve every service request.
Home.portalBody: Register, submit a request, follow the conversation and confirm the resolution.
Home.consoleBody: Team queues, assignment, SLA tracking, private notes and operational reporting.
Home.bilingualBody: Full right-to-left layout, localized dates and bilingual knowledgebase content.
Home.statusBody: This preview validates the project foundation. Customer authentication and ticket workflows are delivered in the next phases.

statusItems.app: Next.js application shell with English and Arabic routing
statusItems.schema: Database schema, constraints and RLS policies prepared as SQL migrations
statusItems.security: Server-only secrets, private storage bucket and security headers configured
statusItems.deploy: Deployment verification pending Supabase and Vercel connection

Home.plannedBody: Phase 2 adds registration, email verification, sign-in and role-aware profiles.
